source_refs.note: Topic 1.6.1 Commonly Used Design Patterns with the class activity (PDF 25, printed 22).

blocks.text: There are many design patterns, but some are used more because they are versatile and effective for a wide range of problems. The most widely recognized ones in this chapter are the Singleton, Factory, Observer and Strategy patterns.

blocks.caption: Four common design patterns
rows: only one object of a kind is created and shared
one key to a special room that everyone uses
ask for an object; the factory decides how to make it
a workshop that hands you the finished product
a source notifies all interested objects when it changes
subscribers who are told of every update
several interchangeable ways to do a task
a toolbox: pick the right tool for the job

blocks.text: Class activity: identify a real-world scenario around you where you could apply one of these design patterns, and share your example in the next class.
